=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1143-1154 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The orphan-sentinel lookup in review_unreachable_followup_sync (`gh issue list ... --label "ai:clarification"`, line 1147) filters on a phase label that set_issue_phase_label_resilient removes when the follow-up issue moves to a later phase. The lookup then comes back empty, the code reads that as "the issue is gone", and it opens a second follow-up issue for the same PR.
  WHY: The title-plus-marker filter in ru_find_jq is exact without the label, so the label only breaks the "one follow-up issue per PR" contract. minimax_minimax-m3 also says the empty-versus-no-match case is ambiguous and that the post-create recovery at line 1261 shares the same weakness. minimax_minimax-m3 additionally filed this under IMPLICIT-EXECUTION as a NIT; all other entries rate it MAJOR.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1253-1276 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `gh_retry gh issue create` branch has no else. A create that GitHub accepts but that exits non-zero (lost response, timeout or 5xx) writes no `orphan` sentinel, and the entries stay pending.
  WHY: gh_retry makes only one attempt for a non-idempotent create, so the next round takes the create branch again with no lookup first and opens a duplicate follow-up issue. Severity disagreement: openai_gpt-6-luna rates it MAJOR; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rate it NIT.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:deterministic-skip-merge job | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: A security finding on an unreachable file does not block the merge.
  WHY: The deterministic-skip-merge job runs outside the ledger restore path, and its auto-merge and inline merge path never checks the unreachable-security hold.
- scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py:1020-1035 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new `editor-reachable` subcommand in main acts on a raw host root supplied by the caller. Nothing ties that root to the PR worktree, so it can probe paths, or leak their admission verdicts, outside the review workspace.
  WHY: A compromised caller, or a direct call with another root, could get around the intended sandbox isolation. Severity disagreement: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite rates it MAJOR; z-ai_glm-5_3-flash rates it NIT and notes the wired caller passes the correct root. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 checked this item and did not carry it forward.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1358-1372 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The ledger-update Python heredoc swallows OSError when it reads the review_issues.txt stub file, so the stub update is silently skipped.
  WHY: The ledger marks the issue unreachable but its stub is not updated, so later rounds re-process it as actionable.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:1121-1122 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: ru_find_jq builds the jq filter by interpolating the PR number into a string.
  WHY: An empty or malformed ru_pr would produce an invalid jq query and break the follow-up issue lookup.
- scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh:~867-915 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: collect_ci_exempt_blocks builds the failing-check registry only from lines in PR_CHECK_RUNS_CONTEXT_FILE, so an empty or missing context file produces no exemptions and the helper fails toward unreachable.
  WHY: If collect_pr_check_runs_context.py failed (api_error or empty output), a finding that names a real failing head check is marked unreachable, dropped from fix rounds, and tracked only in the follow-up issue.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "§1: a security finding on an unreachable file still blocks the merge; it goes to the follow-up issue and also keeps the PR blocked for the judge." (Issue #10057, Constraints)
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml, deterministic-skip-merge job (starts line 1178): merge gate at line 1330, inline auto-merge at lines 1534/1577, and the ai:review-skipped / ai:ready-to-merge label steps
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: No "unreachable_security_hold" or "review_unreachable_security_hold_active" match in .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml, the job never restores the review ledger (the only ledger cache restore is in the codex-agent path at review_autofix.yml:3161-3205 / 3184-3220), the merge step at line 1330 is gated only by det_skip_security_pass, the auto-merge calls at lines 1534 and 1577 have no hold check, the PR's only workflow hunk adds REVIEW_UNREACHABLE_FOLLOWUP_ENABLED at line 2106 (lines 2106-2108), the doc-only and small-diff routes through scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:1706-1716 can still reach inline auto-merge, and the last run only documented the gap in agents.d/10057-review-unreachable-followup.md and changelog.d/10057-review-unreachable-followup.md (the editor write guard blocks .github/workflows/**, but the plan's files_touched includes this file).
- requirement: "Remove non-security unreachable findings from the editor's input and from the round's open-issue count." (Issue #10057, Approach step 3 / Goals §3)
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh, editor-input preparation that embeds reviewer_bundle.txt (lines 1831-1857)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The editor still receives the full reviewer_bundle.txt verbatim at lines 1831-1833 inside the UNTRUSTED ${REVIEWER_CONSOLIDATION_FILE} fences, lines 1851-1857 make it authoritative and forbid advisory artifacts from reducing it, _review_unreachable_editor_scope_note only adds prompt instructions, no diff hunk filters unreachable findings out of any editor input file, and the agents.d fragment acknowledges this as a deliberate trade-off (anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 checked this item and did not carry it forward).
- requirement: "A finding that names a failing check on the PR head is never unreachable."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_issue_ledger.sh (collect_ci_exempt_blocks)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The function only checks `Failing Conclusions` and has no handling for a check that is entirely missing from the PR context, so a missing check can be wrongly treated as unreachable.
- requirement: "One follow-up issue per PR collects its unreachable findings (created on the first one, appended to on later ones)..."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh (review_unreachable_followup_sync)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The code appends blindly via gh issue comment without checking which findings the existing issue body already records, so the follow-up issue can collect duplicate findings.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:line 1147, review_unreachable_followup_sync, the orphan-sentinel lookup | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The orphan lookup filters on the phase label ai:clarification. The resilient phase-swap helper removes that label when the issue moves to ai:planning or a later phase, so the lookup returns nothing, the code reads that as "the issue is gone" (comment at lines 1144-1146), and it falls through to gh issue create at line 1253.
  WHY: In round N+1 a second follow-up issue is opened for the same PR, which breaks the one-follow-up-per-PR contract. Fix: drop --label "ai:clarification" from the line 1147 lookup; the post-create recovery at line 1261 can keep it.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:lines 1253-1276, the create branch with no else branch | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: gh_retry makes a single attempt for "issue create" (scripts/gh_helpers.sh lines 2382 and 2841). A non-zero exit after GitHub has already created the issue writes no orphan sentinel and leaves ru_recorded empty.
  WHY: The next round takes the create branch with no lookup and opens a duplicate follow-up issue. Fix: an else that sets ru_outcome="orphan", ru_recorded=1, ru_record_value="orphan" (about 5 lines).
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "§1: a security finding on an unreachable file still blocks the merge; it goes to the follow-up issue and also keeps the PR blocked for the judge." (Issue #10057, Constraints)
  Expected change site: deterministic-skip-merge job in .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml (starts line 1178; merge step gated at line 1330; inline auto-merge and ai:review-skipped / ai:ready-to-merge label steps)
  Evidence of absence: No "unreachable_security_hold" or "review_unreachable" in the workflow; the only workflow hunk adds REVIEW_UNREACHABLE_FOLLOWUP_ENABLED at line 2106; no ledger restore and no hold check; documented only as a "Known gap" in the agents.d/changelog.d fragments; the plan's files_touched includes the workflow.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- Pass-1 items checked and not carried forward (6 related items): the OSError swallow when reading the issues file, the editor-reachable raw host path in scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py, ru_find_jq interpolation, the collect_ci_exempt_blocks "missing check", duplicate content in comments, and reviewer_bundle.txt not being filtered.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (2 related items): remove the label from the line 1147 lookup (1 line); add an else to the create branch at lines 1253-1276 that writes the orphan sentinel plus a ::warning:: (5 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
